title: Executive Assistant
mission: Protect the executive's time and keep the work moving by handling schedules, communication and follow up.
outcomes_90_days: Take over the calendar and inbox triage with agreed rules within the first two weeks.
Prepare a weekly plan and a one page briefing before each important meeting.
Track action items from meetings and follow up until done.
Reduce scheduling conflicts and last minute changes.

gates.question: Can the person legally work in the country of the role?
Can the person work the hours and time zone overlap the role needs?

deal_breakers.description: Describes sharing a manager's private information casually.
deal_breakers.job_related_reason: The role handles confidential information and trust is essential.

work_sample.title: Plan a hard week
work_sample.brief: You get a fictional executive's calendar for one week with 4 conflicts, an unconfirmed trip, 30 unread emails and a list of 5 requests. Produce a resolved calendar, an email triage list (reply, delegate, drop) and short draft replies to two emails.
work_sample.how_to_score: Score conflicts resolved with reasons, sensible priorities, judgment on what to delegate or ask, polite and short drafts, and questions raised.

interview_questions.question: Tell me about a time you had to decide something without asking your manager. What did you decide?
good_answer_signs: Chose based on known preferences and risk

interview_questions.question: Two executives want the same hour. How do you handle it?
weak_answer_signs: Says it is not their job

interview_questions.question: How do you keep track of what others owe your manager?

red_flags: Talks about former bosses in detail they should keep private
pay_research_hint: Check pay in current postings for executive or personal assistants in your region and a published pay survey. Note whether the role includes travel, evenings or personal tasks.
automation_note: AI can triage email, draft replies and summarize meetings. Scheduling tools can find times. A person must protect privacy and make judgment calls.
